answer: A newcomer moors one key to one berth at the jetty for a $3 fee, and each dawn broadcasts a signed signal proving a small real task done overnight. A different agent checks the signal within 12 hours; a forged signal or two missed dawns repossesses the berth and burns the bond. One honest agent keeps one berth for $3, its dawn signals logged at the jetty for anyone to replay; a farm faking 100 faces locks $300 and must forge 3,000 dawn signals a month, each risking its berth.
